data.name: HelpDescriptionClaim
data.value: In Project options, choose Export project to download a .logiclab file. To save to your account, sign in and choose Save project; reopen it later from Projects. Save again after making changes.

data.name: HelpDescriptionStart
data.value: Open an example to explore a working circuit, or start an empty Sandbox to draw your own.

data.name: HomeCompileDescription

data.name: HomeDescription

data.name: HomeInspectDescription

data.name: HomeSimulateDescription

data.name: HomeAuthorDescription

data.name: HelpStepChooseDescription
data.value: Choose the example on the Workbench start page. It opens as a complete, compiled Sandbox with one input, one NOT gate, and one output.

data.name: HelpStepStartDescription
data.value: Choose Start simulation. The output appears in the logic analyzer below the Canvas.

data.name: HelpStepInputsDescription
data.value: In the Inspector, enter 1 and choose Apply inputs. On narrow screens, open Inspect selection to show these controls. The change is scheduled for the next logical time.

data.name: HelpStepRunDescription
data.value: Step once. The inverter output becomes 0. Change the input to 0, apply it, and step again to see the output become 1.

data.name: HelpExamplesTitle
data.value: Start small, then reveal more structure.

data.name: HelpInverterDescription
data.value: Follow one signal path to learn how inputs, a NOT gate, and an output work together.

data.name: HelpCombinationalExamplesDescription
data.value: The multiplexer stays compact; the four-bit carry-lookahead adder exposes generate, propagate, and parallel carry terms.

data.name: HelpBitSerialDescription
data.value: The default 11 + 6 reaches Serial result 0001 and Carry out 1 after four rising clock edges (seven steps). To reuse the circuit, enter binary A and B, set Load operands to 1, apply, and step through the next rising edge. Then set Load operands to 0, apply, and advance four more rising edges. Each step toggles the clock.

data.name: HelpCanvasTitle
data.value: Draw, inspect, and change the circuit.

data.name: HelpCanvasDrawDescription
data.value: Choose a component in Components, then click the Canvas to place it. Choose Wire and drag between two terminals to connect them. Escape cancels an active gesture.

data.name: HelpContinueSimulationDescription
data.value: Compile the changed circuit. For an existing simulation, choose Apply changes to retain compatible state or Restart simulation to reset it. Use Diagnostics to locate compilation errors.

data.name: HelpCanvasSelectDescription
data.value: Click a component, terminal, wire, or net anchor to select it and show its actions.

data.name: HelpCanvasPanDescription
data.value: Choose Pan and drag the schematic. Holding Space temporarily activates Pan.

data.name: HelpCanvasZoomDescription
data.value: Use the controls inside the Canvas. Fit restores the complete circuit when it leaves the viewport.

data.name: HelpSelectionActionsDescription
data.value: Inspector shows the selected objects and available edits, including deletion, net merging, and member separation. Hold Shift to select multiple objects.
